description: This Java class 'PortUnificationHandler' handles protocol detection and switching for incoming network connections, supporting HTTP, HTTP/2, SOCKS4/5, TLS, and proxy connections within the MockServer project using Netty framework.

classes.name: PortUnificationHandler
classes.description: Handles protocol detection and switching for incoming network connections, supporting HTTP, HTTP/2, SOCKS4/5, TLS, and proxy protocols within the MockServer project using Netty.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Main method that detects protocol type from incoming ByteBuf and switches the pipeline accordingly.

methods.name: logStage
methods.description: Logs the current decoding stage if TRACE logging is enabled.

methods.name: isTls
methods.description: Checks if ByteBuf contains TLS encrypted data.

methods.name: isHttp
methods.description: Detects if ByteBuf contains an HTTP request.

methods.name: switchToHttp2
methods.description: Switches pipeline to handle HTTP/2 protocol.

methods.name: switchToHttp
methods.description: Switches pipeline to handle HTTP/1.1 protocol.

methods.name: isProxyConnected
methods.description: Detects if ByteBuf indicates a proxy connection.

methods.name: switchToProxyConnected
methods.description: Handles switching to proxy connection protocol.

methods.name: readMessage
methods.description: Reads a string message from ByteBuf.

methods.name: switchToBinaryRequestProxying
methods.description: Switches pipeline to handle binary request proxying.

methods.name: getLocalAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves local addresses for the current channel, with caching.

methods.name: calculatePortExtension
methods.description: Calculates port extension string based on port and SSL status.

methods.name: calculateLocalAddresses
methods.description: Generates a set of local address strings for the given socket address.

methods.name: addLastIfNotPresent
methods.description: Adds a handler to pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions during protocol detection and connection handling.
